scope: Strict complete timed Schedule form edit admission and real authenticated loopback HTTP outcomes through the public native facade.

Red.failure: The actual guarded edit is rejected by unsupported command admission.

behavior: HTTP reads supply form hashes used by the complete edit. Fractional instants, complete form, original Schedule identity and changed hash are retained.
Stale form rejects with exactly form, its complete current value and current hash; the entire saved source remains unchanged.
A later start-only Paris form reaches checkpoint 4; exact earlier replay returns checkpoint 3 without reapplying the former form.
Malformed command/change/form/hash objects, UUIDs, DateNumber types, supplied ends, planning zones, escaped unknown fields and deferred all-day variants reject at their expected paths.
Every rejected operation creates no applied Core receipt and retains the full source, issued row window, Item hashes/time and checkpoint 2 without prepared proposals.
Text and structured JSON are checked at the real HTTP boundary, including rejections.

remaining: Zone-only edit, removal, all-day/Itinerary forms and full shared reference graph
Native saved editors and physical CloudKit/account/Share/interruption/performance gates
Chosen clients and signed reader validation
